mechanism: Prednisolone increases sodium retention and potassium excretion while torsemide enhances renal potassium wasting, creating synergistic hypokalemia risk; both drugs can cause fluid retention leading to potential hypervolemia and hypertension.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent, monitor blood pressure and fluid status closely during concurrent use.
